method: Runs entirely in the browser. Each non-empty line is parsed independently. The checksum is the XOR of printable ASCII bytes between the start delimiter and asterisk; mismatches remain visible with decoded fields, RMC requires a checksum, and other sentence types can optionally require one. Standard five-character addresses are split into talker and formatter. GGA, RMC, GLL, GSA, GSV and VTG receive strict field, range, units and cross-field decoding; other types retain their ordered fields. Coordinates convert ddmm/dddmm minutes to signed decimal degrees, RMC years use the 1973 pivot, and invalid fixes may omit unavailable positions. Published receiver examples and nmea-simple 3.3.0 supplied independent fixtures and randomized differential comparisons.
